podcast.body: This single was released as the follow-up to Sloan's debut album, "Smeared." "That snaps us all the way back to the first album smeared in 1992. That was the follow up to the single underwhelmed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Sloan In Their Own Words: Part 2

podcast.body: This song was featured on Sloan's debut EP "The Peppermint-eaky" and later on "Smeared." Its unique title caught the attention of Todd Sullivan from Geffen Records, leading to Sloan's major label signing. In 1996, Chart Magazine ranked it as the number two Canadian song of all time, and Chris Murphy, the writer, often noted his personal connection to the word's usage. "The original version of Underwhelmed from Sloan's debut release, which is called The Peppermint-eaky."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
